title-group.article-title: On the classification of simple and complex cells

abstract.p: We show that the modulation ratio distribution of cat primary visual cortex is bimodal.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Simple and complex cells were defined by Hubel and Wiesel1 on the basis of receptive field structure.

sec.title: Modulation ratio
sec.p: The distribution of modulation ratios is bimodal, with a clear gap between the two groups of cells.
